title: Four Desks and a Sheet
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：stage　|　正文 290 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In November our class decided to ① stage a short play for the school drama festival. There was no theatre, no curtain and no money, so the ② stage itself was four desks pushed together and a blue sheet hung behind them on a washing line. Stages are cruel places: they show everything, including what nobody meant to show.

③ At an early stage everything went wrong. The actor playing the father forgot his entrance twice; the lights would not dim; and for eleven minutes ④ nobody on stage looked at anybody else, which is worse than forgetting a line. Our teacher sat in the third row and said only one thing: 'Again.'

Slowly things changed. Someone found three old lamps, and their warm light ⑤ set the stage for the last scene better than any argument in the rehearsal room had done. props arrived from people's homes: a real kettle, two cups, a radio that no longer worked but looked exactly right.

When the caretaker tried to take our desks away we ⑥ staged a small, silent protest by sitting on the floor and refusing to move until the head teacher came. He laughed, gave us two extra afternoons, and told us we would regret it. He was right about that.

The little tour afterwards had three ⑦ stages: our own hall, a village school forty minutes away, and finally a real theatre in the county town. My sister always wanted to ⑧ go on the stage, and by the third night I understood why. ⑨ Stage by stage, the play found its shape, and by the last performance even the silence had timing. I did not become an actor. But I learned that a bare ⑩ stage asks one question only: are you willing to be seen trying?

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: D. v. 上演；举办（stage a play/exhibition）
E. v. 组织；发起（抗议、活动）
F. 固定搭配：on stage 在舞台上
G. 固定搭配：set the stage for 为……创造条件／铺垫
H. 固定搭配：go on the stage 登台演戏；当演员

items.q: decided to stage a short play
the stage itself was four desks pushed together
At an early stage everything went wrong
nobody on stage looked at anybody else
their warm light set the stage for the last scene
we staged a small, silent protest
The little tour afterwards had three stages
wanted to go on the stage
Stage by stage, the play found its shape
a bare stage asks one question only

answers.why: stage＋宾语 a short play，是动词“上演、排演”，指班级决定演一出短剧。
被 four desks pushed together 说明，是名词“舞台”，指临时搭的表演区。
at an early stage 意为“在早期阶段”，指排练初期一切都出错。
on stage 意为“在舞台上”，此处说台上没人看别人，比忘词更糟。
set the stage for sth 意为“为……作铺垫、创造条件”，暖光为最后一幕营造氛围。
stage＋protest 是动词“发起、组织（抗议等活动）”，此处是静坐抗议。
three stages 指巡演的三“站”，后接本校礼堂、乡村学校、县城剧场。
go on the stage 意为“当演员、登台演出”，姐姐一直想投身演戏。
stage by stage 意为“逐步地”，这里的 stage 仍是“阶段”，表示渐进过程。
a bare stage 指空荡荡的“舞台”，与第 2 题同为名词“舞台”。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我们班决定为戏剧节上演一出短剧。（stage v.）
在最初阶段，一切都出了问题。（at an early stage）
我们的舞台只是四张课桌拼起来的。（stage n.）
暖色的灯光为最后一幕营造了氛围。（set the stage for）
那次小小的巡演一共有三站。（stage n.）
我姐姐一直想成为一名演员。（go on the stage）
answers: Our class decided to stage a short play for the drama festival.
At an early stage everything went wrong.
Our stage was only four desks pushed together.
The warm light set the stage for the last scene.
The little tour had three stages in all.
My sister always wanted to go on the stage.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 stage 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Our class decided to stage a short play for the drama festival, though we had no theatre and no curtain.
The stage itself was four desks pushed together, with a blue sheet hanging behind them.
At an early stage nobody on stage looked at anybody else, which is worse than forgetting an entrance.
